name: AWS Certified Security – Specialty

fee.note: USD list price. A qualifying unused AWS exam discount could reduce it to $150; not account-verified.

exam.format: 65 questions (multiple choice, multiple response, ordering and matching), 170 minutes, at a Pearson VUE test center or online proctored. AWS's intended audience has five years in IT security and two securing AWS workloads; no prior certification is required.

scope: Securing AWS workloads: identity and access, data protection, detection, incident response and infrastructure security.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: The Spanish (Latin America) version is retired after December 31, 2026, along with Portuguese (Brazil) and Simplified Chinese.

discounts.text: After you earn an AWS Certification, AWS gives you a 50% discount voucher for recertification or any other AWS exam.

access.retake: After a failed attempt you wait 14 calendar days; there is no limit on attempts, but each one costs the full exam fee.
access.accommodations: Non-native English speakers taking the exam in English can request 30 extra minutes (ESL +30) once in their AWS Certification account; it then applies to every booking.

timeline.text: Last day for the Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil) and Simplified Chinese versions; from 2027 the exam is offered in English, Japanese and Korean.

prep.title: Exam Prep Plan: AWS Certified Security - Specialty (SCS-C03 - Español LATAM)
prep.note: AWS's 4-step exam prep plan in Latin American Spanish; some trainings in it need a Skill Builder subscription.
